heading.title: Of Discharge from Liability on Notes, Bills and Cheques

article.title: Discharge by allowing drawee more than forty-eight hours to accept.
article.content: If the holder of a bill of exchange allows the drawee more than 1[forty-eight] hours, exclusive of public holidays, to consider whether he will accept the same, all previous parties not consenting to such allowance are thereby discharge from liability to such holder.
article.html:
83Discharge by allowing drawee more than forty-eight hours to accept.

Section 83 · Chapter VII · page 20 of the Act

If the holder of a bill of exchange allows the drawee more than 1[forty-eight] hours, exclusive of public holidays, to consider whether he will accept the same, all previous parties not consenting to such allowance are thereby discharge from liability to such holder.

1 Subs. by Act 12 of 1921, s. 2, for “twenty-four”.
